fees.note: Two people, one night: $40. There is no camping fee; the cost is Colorado Parks and Wildlife's State Wildlife Area pass, which everyone 16 or older needs on the property. 2 people x 2 one-day passes x $10 = $40: a one-day pass is valid only on the date printed on it, and a night spans the arrival and departure dates. Nobody holding an annual Colorado fishing, small-game, big-game or turkey license needs the pass, and neither do under-16s. An annual SWA pass is $43.87 (March 1 to March 31 of the next year; youth/senior $11.96). The pass is per person, not per vehicle; buy it online or in the My CPW app, up to 60 days ahead. (AWH 2026-10-11: price as two people, one night.)

source: https://cpw.state.co.us/swa-finder (everyone 16+ needs an SWA pass or a hunting/fishing license; one-day pass $10, valid only on its date; annual $43.87; license exemptions) and https://cpw.state.co.us/state-wildlife-areas/san-luis-lakes-swa (camping in designated areas, no camping fee listed); two people, one night per AWH 2026-10-11
